system.description: Warrior Mage Base 14.6.5 - Warrior's Weapon. Spells that enchant, empower, and control a single personal melee weapon, the caster's 'Warrior's Weapon'. A given caster can only have one weapon enchanted through the spells on this list; if that weapon is ever lost or destroyed, the caster suffers a penalty of -25 to all actions for two weeks (after which he can enchant a new weapon). All of the spells on this list deal directly with the Warrior's Weapon and will only work when used with one.

Caster enchants a melee weapon which is to become his 'Warrior's Weapon.' This spell grants the weapon a +5 magic bonus. Anyone other than the caster who attempts to utilize this weapon will receive a penalty to its use equal to the bonus it gives the caster.
Causes the warrior's weapon to glow with light. This light may be varied by the caster from as bright as a torch to as dim as a candle.

Caster's warrior weapon is charged with electrical energy for the duration of this spell. Whenever the caster gets a critical result with the weapon it does an additional 'A' Electricity critical. Alternatively, throughout the duration of this spell, the caster may elect to shoot this electrical energy in the form of a shock bolt with a maximum range of 50' (which immediately ends this spell). The caster may develop skill in shooting this bolt.

Caster may throw his weapon for the duration with a maximum range equal to his strength bonus x10 in feet (with a minimum of 30'). The weapon attacks on its normal table with the following modifications: up to one tenth maximum range +10, up to quarter maximum range +0, up to half maximum range -40, up to maximum range -70.
Caster may store one spell on his weapon. No other spell may be cast while one is stored. This spell costs the same amount of PPs as the spell to be stored.
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +10 magic weapon.
Caster is able to repair any damage to his weapon. Caster is able to rejoin a broken portion of up to 1 linear inch per level.
As Jolting Blade, except can inflict up to an 'A' Heat Critical. The caster may elect to throw a firebolt with a maximum range of 100'.

Caster's weapon will fly through the air to return to the caster's hand at the rate of 100' per round. If the weapon is restrained it cannot break free, but if someone is holding it they must make a hard strength maneuver to not lose their grip on the weapon.
Caster is able to use his full weapon OB as a parry against missile attacks for the duration of this spell.
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +15 magic weapon.

Caster 'absorbs' one warrior weapon, and reproduces it at need (by recasting this spell each time the weapon is sheathed or unsheathed). The mass and weight of the weapon are added to the caster's mass while the weapon is sheathed.
As Return Blade, except weapon returns to caster's hand, via teleport, from any place, up to 1 mile away per level of caster.

Caster causes his weapon to build up concussive energy. If the next strike made with the weapon results in a critical, an extra Impact critical of one less severity is inflicted (treat an 'A' critical as an 'A' critical -25).

Caster's next successful strike against any enchanted item, weapon, etc, causes the item to make an RR versus the caster's level (with a special modification of -20) or the embedded spells are dispelled.
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +20 magic weapon.
As Jolting Blade, except can inflict up to a 'C' Electricity critical. The caster may elect to throw a lightning bolt with a maximum range of 150'.

Causes caster's weapon to be a 'Cleaving' weapon. When a foe's weapon successfully parries its attack, the defending weapon must check for breakage. The strength of the caster's weapon is subtracted from the foe's breakage check.
Caster causes his weapon's next attack to be made on the attack table of the caster's choice.
If caster's next attack this round inflicts a critical, it does an additional 'E' critical of the caster's choice.

Caster's weapon will 'dance' for the duration of this spell. The caster must fight with the weapon for one round prior to letting the weapon 'dance.' The weapon will have an OB of half the caster's normal OB. It has an AT of 20, a DB of +0, and can take 5 hits per level of the caster (before this spell is dispelled). Once this spell is cast, the sword will not stop attacking until it is dispelled or the duration ends.

Caster may roll any criticals he inflicts with his Warrior Weapon this round on the Slaying column of the Large Creature Critical Strike Table. If the target is Super Large, the caster rolls on the Slaying column of the Super Large Critical Strike Table.
